technical.summary: Multiple oversold indicators suggest potential bounce, but price remains below all key moving averages with weak trend structure and negative money flow—insufficient confluence for high-probability entry.

fundamental.summary: ACN shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 66 days adds timing risk with no offsetting fundamental catalysts.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (28/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but congressional activity is mixed and minimal with no clear conviction signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (404.96), flat yield curve signals recession risk, rising DXY pressures multinational earnings, with earnings event 66 days out adding binary risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Extreme oversold conditions (RSI, Stochastic, Williams %R) combined with fear-zone sentiment (VIX crisis) and contrarian buy signal create a classic bounce setup near support at 297.30.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price is below all major moving averages with bearish trend structure, negative money flow (CMF), weak ADX, no active strategy confluence, severe macro headwinds (VIX 404.96, flat yield curve, rising DXY), and high earnings risk in 66 days with zero fundamental catalysts or insider conviction.
